trustRules: All target labels, point values, node identities, ranks, edges, lock states and service statuses are placeholders and never runtime facts.
The target defines the ten-region composition and baseline visual density; the API defines the real 111 nodes, section counts, ranks, coordinates, parent edges and point caps.
All real nodes remain reachable in an internal tree scroll surface; the route must not delete nodes to force the target placeholder count of 19.
Only backend node iconUrl values accepted by the trusted runtime media allowlist may represent real talents; generated art may only frame those icons.
spellReady=false and 55 unresolved formulas require a partial evidence state; unresolved descriptions cannot be presented as complete spell text.
encodingReady=true does not make a blocked empty talentImport usable. Copy and save stay disabled until status is verified and importCode is non-empty.
Community templates are source references only until a verified import can be decoded or returned; the route must not fabricate selected ranks from template titles.
Loading, empty, blocked and error states retain all ten target regions and the target's 19-socket loading density.
